column1: # v3.76 — every committed screenshot, and whether anything regenerates it.
# produces 12. The other 15 are frozen at whatever the UI looked like on
# the day somebody took them, and nothing says which day that was or
# whether the product still behaves that way.
# That is how 17-attribution-heatmap.png survived: it is captioned in
# both READMEs as showing an attribution overlay and a 6-axis chip strip,
# the overlay was never implemented, and the chip strip it does show is
# not in the page any more. Four months on the front door.
#   scripted         the capture script produces it; re-shot every time
#   manual-verified  not scripted, but a human confirmed the UI still
#                    looks like this, on the date given
#   stale            nobody has confirmed it since it was taken
#   retired          the UI it shows is gone; the image must not be

column4: Free-pick A/B compare. Not scripted; the lightbox has changed several times since.

Marquee drag-select and the bulk toolbar it pops up. Scripting it failed in v3.86: the handler returns unless the drag starts in grid empty space, and two attempts at a start point selected nothing. Faking the CSS class would photograph selected-looking cards with no toolbar, which is a picture of the feature rather than the feature.
Shot when the popover fired on score_final 0.45-0.55. v3.76 made it fire on decision=maybe instead, so this shows a state that can no longer occur.
Captioned as an attribution heatmap overlay plus a 6-axis chip strip. The overlay never existed (v3.75 removed the key that claimed it); the chip strip is not in the current page.
